# macOS-style keyboard shortcuts (KDE)

Shortcuts use symbol notation: **⌘** Command (Meta), **⇧** Shift, **⌥** Option (Alt), **⌃** Control.

---

## Application shortcuts (StandardShortcuts)

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| About app | ⌘⇧? |
| Activate next tab | ⌃] or ⌃PgDown |
| Activate previous tab | ⌃PgUp or ⌃[ |
| Actual size | ⌃0 |
| Add bookmark | ⌃B |
| Back | ⌥← |
| Backward word | ⌃← |
| Begin of document | ⌘Home |
| Beginning of line | Home |
| Clear | Delete |
| Close | ⌘W or ⌘Esc |
| Copy | ⌘C |
| Create folder | ⌘⇧N |
| Cut | ⌘X |
| Delete file | ⌘⌥Backspace |
| Delete word back | ⌥Backspace |
| Delete word forward | ⌘Del |
| Deselect all | ⌘⇧A |
| Document back | ⌥⇧← |
| Document forward | ⌥⇧→ |
| Edit bookmarks | ⌘⌥B |
| End of document | ⌘End |
| End of line | End |
| Find | ⌘F |
| Find next | F3 |
| Find previous | ⇧F3 |
| Forward | ⌥→ |
| Forward word | ⌃→ |
| Full screen | ⌘⇧F |
| Go to | ⌘⇧G |
| Go to line | ⌘G |
| Help | F1 |
| Key bindings | ⌘⌥, |
| Mail | ⌘⇧M |
| Move to trash | ⌘Backspace |
| New | ⌘N |
| Next completion | ⌘↓ |
| Open | ⌘O |
| Open context menu | ⇧F10 |
| Open main menu | F10 |
| Open recent | ⌘⇧O |
| Paste | ⌘V |
| Paste selection | ⌘⇧Ins |
| Preferences | ⌘, |
| Previous completion | ⌘↑ |
| Print | ⌘P |
| Print preview | ⌘⇧P |
| Prior (page up) | PgUp |
| Quit | ⌘Q |
| Redo | ⌘⇧Z |
| Reload | F5 or ⌘R |
| Rename file | ⇧Return |
| Replace | ⌘⌥F |
| Revert | ⌘⇧R |
| Save | ⌘S |
| Save as | ⌘⇧S |
| Select all | ⌘A |
| Show/hide hidden files | ⌘⇧. |
| Show menubar | ⌃M |
| Spelling | ⌘; |
| Substring completion | ⌘T |
| Text completion | ⌘E |
| Undo | ⌘Z |
| Up (parent folder) | ⌥↑ |
| What's this | ⇧F1 |
| Zoom in | ⌃+ or ⌃= |
| Zoom out | ⌃- |

---

## Keyboard layout

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Switch to last-used layout | ⌘⌥L |
| Switch to next layout | ⌘⌥K |

---

## Session & lock (ksmserver)

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Lock session | ⌘⌃Q or ⌘L |
| Log out | ⌃⌥Del |

---

## Window management (KWin)

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Activate window demanding attention | ⌘⌃A |
| Cycle overview (Mission Control) | ⌃↑ |
| Cycle overview opposite (App windows) | ⌃↓ |
| Exposé | ⌃F10 |
| Exposé all | ⌃F9 |
| Exposé by class | ⌃F7 |
| Invert colors | ⌘⌃I |
| Invert window colors | ⌘⌃U |
| Kill window (Force quit) | ⌥⌘Esc |
| Minimize all (show desktop) | ⌘⇧D |
| Move mouse to center | ⌘F6 |
| Move mouse to focus | ⌘F5 |
| Show desktop | F11 |
| Suspend compositing | ⌥⇧F12 |
| Switch one desktop down | ⌘⌃↓ |
| Switch one desktop up | ⌘⌃↑ |
| Switch one desktop left | ⌘⌃← |
| Switch one desktop right | ⌘⌃→ |
| Switch window down | ⌘⌥↓ |
| Switch window left | ⌘⌥← |
| Switch window right | ⌘⌥→ |
| Switch window up | ⌘⌥↑ |
| Switch to desktop 1–9 | ⌃F1 – ⌃F9 |
| Switch to next desktop | ⌃→ |
| Switch to previous desktop | ⌃← |
| Walk through windows (switch apps) | ⌘Tab |
| Walk through windows (reverse) | ⌘⇧Tab |
| Walk through windows of current app | ⌘` |
| Walk through windows of current app (reverse) | ⌘⇧` |
| Window close | ⌥F4 |
| Window maximize | ⌘PgUp |
| Window minimize | ⌘PgDown |
| Window operations menu | ⌥F3 |
| Window quick tile right | ⌘→ |
| Window to next screen | ⌘⇧→ |
| Window to previous screen | ⌘⇧← |
| Disable input capture | ⌘⇧Esc |
| View actual size | ⌘0 |
| View zoom in | ⌘+ or ⌘= |
| View zoom out | ⌘- |

## Volume (kmix)

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Decrease volume | Volume Down |
| Decrease volume (small) | ⇧Volume Down |
| Increase volume | Volume Up |
| Increase volume (small) | ⇧Volume Up |
| Mute | Volume Mute |
| Mic mute | ⌘Volume Mute |
| Decrease microphone | Microphone Volume Down |
| Increase microphone | Microphone Volume Up |

## Media control

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Next media | Media Next |
| Pause | Media Pause |
| Play | Media Play |
| Previous media | Media Previous |
| Stop | Media Stop |

## Power & display (Power Devil)

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Power profile / battery | ⌘B |
| Decrease keyboard brightness | Keyboard Brightness Down |
| Decrease screen brightness | Monitor Brightness Down |
| Increase keyboard brightness | Keyboard Brightness Up |
| Increase screen brightness | Monitor Brightness Up |
| Sleep | Sleep |
| Hibernate | Hibernate |

| Run clipboard | ⌘⇧V |

|--------|----------|

| Rectangular region | ⌘⇧4 or ⌘⇧Print |
| Active window | ⌘⌃Print |
| Window under cursor | ⌘⌥Print |
| Record region | ⌘⇧5 |
| Record screen | ⌘⌥R |

| Action | Shortcut |
